description.value: The Bulkley Valley Motel is an owner-operated motel in New Hazelton on Highway 16, sitting at the junction with Highway 37 between Prince George and Prince Rupert — a natural overnight stop on the northern BC touring corridor. It claims to be the only property in New Hazelton with full-sized kitchen units, with four such rooms available alongside standard rooms, all positioned away from the highway and railway tracks for a quieter rest. The surrounding block includes a grocery store next door, a laundromat across the street, and five restaurants within 200 metres.

address.value: 4444 Highway 16, Box 6, New Hazelton, BC V0J 2J0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms operational status, phone number, and the motel's general character. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, leaving both required criteria null. Wi-Fi, a nearby laundromat, multiple restaurants, and a next-door grocery store are explicitly confirmed on the /rooms and front pages. The website's contact page lists '4444 Highway 16' while OSM records '4444 10th Avenue' — flagged as a discrepancy, though these may be dual designations for the same road through New Hazelton.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records '4444 10th Avenue' but the website contact page states '4444 Highway 16, Box 6' — may be dual designations for the same road but should be verified.

Pet policy is internally inconsistent: the front page banner states the motel 'is no longer pet-friendly' while the /rooms page simultaneously advertises 'WE CHARGE FOR DOGS -- CALL FOR AVAILABLE DOG ROOMS.' Website may not have been fully updated.
Website front page displays a placeholder/template phone number 'TEL:123-456-7890' alongside the real number — likely a site-builder artifact but suggests the site may not be actively maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The motel is clearly operational and well-placed on a major cycling corridor, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure knowledge) is confirmed anywhere on the website; direct outreach to ownership is needed before a listing is warranted.
enrichment_extras.notes: Owner-operated by Howard Broten. Email confirmed from website: bvmotellz@gmail.com. Four full-sized kitchen units described as the only such rooms in New Hazelton.

Laundry.detail: Laundromat is across the street (stated on /rooms page under 'Amenities Close By')

Nearby evening food.detail: 5 restaurants within 200 metres of the motel (per /rooms page)

Nearby grocery.detail: Grocery store is next door (per /rooms page and front page)

wow_evidence: owner-operated motel... only property in New Hazelton with full-sized kitchen units
